turns.prompt_text: explain heart rate variability to me
turns.response_html: Heart rate variability is the natural fluctuation in the time interval between consecutive heartbeats. This variation, regulated by the autonomic nervous system, reflects your body's ability to adapt to stress and is a key indicator of overall health and fitness. A higher HRV is generally associated with a healthy, well-recovered state, while a lower HRV can signal stress, fatigue, or illness.
